feature: Event Detail period market support contract

contract.validPayload: route-backed first-half/second-half winner markets must be declared in event.supportedMarketTypes and backed by a matching backend market.
contract.malformedPayload: a period winner market for an undeclared period is rejected before Event Detail applies the payload.
contract.localPayload: non-route-backed/local Event Detail may still use fallback period winner fixtures.
